Results.ReviewText: My previous Weber  kettle lasted 10 years. This new one cooks as good but there seems to have been some cutbacks to save money.  One less handle. I drop my kettle in a concret countertop with the proper hole cut out, but with only one handle, it was lopsided,  so I had to MacGyver something.  Also, the paint finish (Crimson Red) was disappointing.  Very low gloss finish.  As of there was no clearcoat on it. My previous had a nice gloss finish that was easy to clean. Not this one. I also chose to replace the chrome grill that does not last with a cast iron grill.
Results.Title: Cooks as good as my previous one but with cutbacks

Results.ReviewText:
Its a nice grill. Built well and pretty solid. Easy to assemble out of the box, its a 10 minute job. 
The hook for hanging the lid off the side takes some getting used to, but its effective for its purpose.
Why only 4 stars? I only found out after purchasing that this $250 grill does not come with a simple heat resistant plastic handle for the dome damper that weber probably makes for a few pennies, and includes on higher end models… I consider that a miss on webers part, not including this could also be considered a safety flaw. Think about it. Its a part that is meant to be handled many times while cooking, and could easily cause burn injuries without using appropriate precautions.
Weber needs to step up and provide this part on all of their grills.
In the past i had bought a small $15 throwaway kettle for a temporary work site that had a heat resistant damper handle, but weber doesn’t provide one on the premium kettle?
I found a few aftermarket pieces that will fit, but most are out of stock. Now I know why.
Results.Title: Almost 5 stars

Results.ReviewText: The only issue i had was not knowing where to move the bottom vent to closed it or open part way, it was frustrating , so after my cook n letting it cool down, n had to mark where it was closed , open etc. Would be nice if it was marked more clearly on that.

The only problem I  had was inserting the legs into the body. They were very tight and would not insert all the way. I had to sand the legs and the kettle body so they would go all the wat in and lock. 
The grill works fine! I would definitely buy again!!!

Results.ReviewText: I have used the grill almost every day since purchasing. My only complaint is that it is too short (I am 6'3). I did the extended leg mod found on YouTube and now it is perfect
Results.Title: Excellent

Results.ReviewText: I just bought my third 22in Weber grill.  I bought my first one in about 1979, and used it for 18 years until a leg rusted off.  Then I bought my second one with the propane charcoal lighter and work table.  That was my favorite one, and I used it for 28 years, rebuilding it once by replacing the ash removal blades and the gas lighter tube.  I just bought my third Weber grill, and probably won't need to buy another one because of my age.  I use my grills several times a month, and I estimate that I have cooked at least 50 turkeys on my Weber grills, and countless other things.  I think they are the best.
Results.Title: The only grill I have owned.

Results.ReviewText: This grill gets the job done. I grilled yesterday and the grill was over 500 degrees. I like to read instruction manuals. There are a few things you should know about the grill before using it so please take the time. I'm very satisfied with the grill. There's is one thing, the instructions mention using 50 briquettes. I tried 50 and that was not enough, it is a fairly large grill. Next time, I doubled it to 100 and it was really hot. Maybe 75 would be a good number - 50 not enough and 100 maybe too much. You will have to experiment for yourself like anything else. We have only used it two times so far. It is well designed, easy to use, not hard to clean. I like the copper-colored grill.
Results.Title: Works great

Results.ReviewText: Just like a Weber! Heats up and cools down fast. Greatest grill for the money.
Results.Title: Weber

Results.ReviewText: Amazing design. Quality craftsmanship and clever design for how charcoal is easily sifted through the bottom, making cleanup a breeze! This is important as it extends the life of the grill exponentially! The thermometer in the lid is handy too - allowing you to check temperature at a glance without opening the lid. Everything about the design seems well thought out - making all aspects of the grilling process convenient.
Results.Title: Excellent design and craftsmanship - perfect grill

Results.ReviewText: Back to "old school" bbqing and loving it. Aside from waiting for the charcoal to be ready ( a great time to have a beverage) I find it faster than a gas grill. The taste brings me back to my younger days before gas grills. Im loving it.
Results.Title: The good ol' days.

Results.ReviewText: I waited for a sale, but there were no discount promotions, so I bought it at the regular price. There was a deep scratch on the lid, probably due to a delivery issue, but it worked fine. I think there is nothing better than this for charcoal grilling. It seems to be the best grill.
Results.Title: Best gill

Results.ReviewText: My Weber Original Kettle Grill is Awesome. It is perfect in every way. I love it. I am a grill guy and I have been cooking on Weber Grills since I was 12 years old.  I am 59, but I look like I am 39. My favorite thing to cook on my grill is steak, burgers and brats.
Results.Title: The Weber Grill King

Results.ReviewText: I've used the Webber kettle for years. It's hard to beat these grills.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: Beat charcoal grill on the market. We have really enjoyed it. Use it 2-3 times per week
Results.Title: Amazing Grill

Results.ReviewText: Golden standard in charcoal grills - that’s enough said…

Results.ReviewText: It arrived on time and was easy to assemble. It maintained the temperature and exceeded my grilling expectations.
Results.Title: Seriously great

Results.ReviewText: So far so good, I hesitated giving it 5 stars because I've only used it twice, but it's off to a great start.   Easy to assemble (though I had assembled one for my son previously) and the quick start chimney think I bought with it works very well--lights up fast!
Results.Title: So far so good.

Results.ReviewText: This should be the standard for grills. I have already made masterpieces on it and bought almost every accessory. I looove it thank you Weber. I may name my next dog Weber. I can’t wait for football season
Results.Title: I Love it!

Results.ReviewText: This my fourth weber charcoal in 20+ years. Changed a little over the years with great flavor and appearances of food. I love the ash catcher.so much cleaner. Always cook a turkey for thankgiving every year.
Results.Title: Best there is

Results.ReviewText: It was bit awkward to assemble, but once I got it together it's the best all around charcoal grill I've ever owned.  I had an original Kettle Grill many years ago, so I appreciate the features of the Premium model.  Ash collection, hinged grill and thermometer are well worth the upgrade to the Premium model.
Results.Title: Best charcoal grill I've ever owned.

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
